headline: Mister Organ is one of the most unsettling documentaries I’ve ever seen
summary: David Farrier's new documentary, "Mister Organ," explores a man's intimate campaign of terror. The film depicts Michael Organ's deeply unsettling influence on those around him. Reviewers describe the documentary as profoundly disturbing.

headline: A woman was arrested in Philly for blocking a delivery robot
summary: Carolyn Marvin was arrested in Philadelphia for blocking an Uber delivery robot. She faced disorderly conduct charges after refusing to move. Marvin stated she was protesting to protect human delivery jobs.

headline: Video game ownership bill introduced in Congress
summary: Rep. Ritchie Torres introduced the 'Power To The Players Act' in Congress. The bill aims to guarantee consumer ownership of purchased video games. It seeks to prevent games from being treated merely as licensed software.

headline: Lenovo’s fast, comfy SteamOS handheld is hundreds off
summary: The Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS is now available at a significant discount. It offers a larger 8-inch 120Hz screen and more RAM/storage than Steam Deck OLED. This handheld provides a powerful and more affordable alternative for gaming on the go.

headline: Silent Hill Remake Studio Wants to Make Physical Games 'for as Long as Possible'
summary: Bloober Team, the studio behind the Silent Hill remake, strongly supports physical game releases. They expressed a commitment to producing physical editions for as long as feasible. This stance highlights a preference for tangible media in the gaming industry.

headline: Street Fighter Tops the Box Office With $51 Million Opening Weekend Amid Lackluster Reviews
summary: Capcom's "Street Fighter" movie grossed $51.1 million on its opening weekend. Despite receiving lackluster reviews, the film topped the global box office. This strong performance signals a successful theatrical debut for the video game adaptation.

headline: The Best Deals Today: The Adventures of Elliot, Pikmin 4, Mouse: P.I. For Hire, and More
summary: Discover today's top gaming and entertainment deals. Featured offers include discounted prices on "The Adventures of Elliot" and "Pikmin 4." Find great savings on "Mouse: P.I. For Hire" and other popular titles.

headline: Quentin Tarantino Says He's 'Written a Script' for 10th and Final Film, But He Wants to 'Live' Before Making It
summary: Quentin Tarantino has confirmed he's completed a script for his rumored 10th and final film. However, the director intends to take a break before starting production. He stated he wants to "live" a little before making his last movie.

headline: What we know so far about deadly fire at Canadian military base
summary: A devastating fire swept through a Canadian military base, resulting in multiple casualties. At least four people have been confirmed dead following the incident. Authorities are currently investigating the cause and full extent of the tragedy.

headline: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
summary: Paris streets show widespread damage following recent protests that escalated into riots. Burnt out cars and shattered glass are visible across the city. Approximately 1,800 people were arrested amid outbreaks of violence and looting.

headline: Polanski says he will not overturn Green Party's 'Zionism is racism' motion
summary: The Green Party leader, Polanski, confirmed he would not overturn the controversial 'Zionism is racism' motion. Despite a desire to amend it, the motion will stand within the party until 2028. This decision maintains a divisive stance within the Green Party's policy.

headline: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
summary: The United States is facing a deepening crisis due to a surge in homemade, synthetic drugs. This deadly epidemic is impacting users, dealers, and recovery efforts nationwide. BBC News reports on the growing struggle against these potent and dangerous substances.
